articles.summary: As the city awoke my first morning in Kathmandu I was serenaded by the sounds of barking dogs, motorbikes and loud men on bikes assumingly trying to sell things.  Any negative feelings this caused were immediately washed away as I sat up and saw the city for the first time.
articles.title: Waking up in Kathmandu
